name: io.github.Servosity/cloudally-mcp
title: CloudAlly MCP
description: CloudAlly Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace backup: accounts, backup tasks, status and restores

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDALLY_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The client-id of your CloudAlly API application (partner portal > Integrations > REST API), sent as the client-id header on every request.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDALLY_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The client-secret of the same API application, sent as the client-secret header on every request.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDALLY_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional override; leave blank. Run `cloudally-cli auth login --partner` (or `auth login` for one company) in a terminal instead, which saves and refreshes the token. A pasted token expires and keeps overriding the saved one.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDALLY_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Company account login used by `auth login`; every command is then limited to that one company. Most operators run `auth login` once in a terminal and leave this blank.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDALLY_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Password for the company account login above.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDALLY_PARTNER_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Partner portal login used by `auth login --partner`; it reaches every customer account and is needed for the distributor and reseller commands and `auth use-account`.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDALLY_PARTNER_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Password for the partner portal login above.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDALLY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional; leave blank. Sends every CloudAlly API call to this base URL instead of https://api.cloudally.com, for tests and mock servers.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDALLY_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to hide tools that change CloudAlly state (restores, task changes, account changes, deletes) and refuse non-GET execute calls. Tools still write local state: the response cache and learning entries.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDALLY_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Leave blank for Claude Desktop.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDALLY_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to CloudAlly. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank.
